supplements.title: Dual-ligand-modified cantharidin nanoparticles for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma via the inhibition of Ephb4.
supplements.summary: Modified nanoparticles delivering cantharidin effectively treat liver cancer by blocking a specific protein pathway while reducing toxic side effects.

supplements.title: Chronic stress at the crossroads: Decoding the HPA-SAM-immune-gut axis in inflammatory bowel disease pathogenesis and therapeutics.
supplements.summary: Chronic stress worsens inflammatory bowel disease by disrupting immune function and gut bacteria; psychological therapies combined with standard treatments may help.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the efficacy of rutin, rutin nanocrystals, and rutin spanlastics nanoparticles as antitumor and antioxidant drug delivery systems.
supplements.summary: Rutin delivered as spanlastic nanoparticles showed superior antioxidant and anticancer effects against breast cancer cells compared to regular rutin.

supplements.title: Integrated Genomic, Structural, and Metabolomic Profiling of Freeze-Dried Postbiotic Supernatants Reveals Multi-Target Anticancer Activity Against Caco-2 Cells.
supplements.summary: Bacterial metabolites derived from probiotics show promise against colorectal cancer cells by triggering cell death and stopping tumor growth.

supplements.title: Plant‑derived natural products alleviate dexamethasone‑induced skeletal muscle atrophy by modulating FoxO (Review).
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds prevent muscle wasting caused by dexamethasone by targeting the FoxO protein and related cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the combined cytotoxic and apoptotic potential of green-synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (from Thymus vulgaris) and tamoxifen on MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Thymus-derived zinc oxide nanoparticles combined with tamoxifen kill breast cancer cells while using 96-fold less tamoxifen dose.

supplements.title: Alpha‑lipoic acid-loaded chitosan nanoparticles ameliorate streptozotocin‑induced diabetic liver injury via Nrf2/HO‑1 activation and TLR4/NF‑κB and JAK2/STAT1 inhibition.
supplements.summary: Alpha-lipoic acid in nanoparticles protects diabetic liver injury better than free drug by reducing oxidative stress and inflammation.

supplements.title: The Science of Colour in Rice: A Review on Health Benefits, Genetic Regulation, and Anthocyanin Stability.
supplements.summary: Pigmented rice varieties contain anthocyanins and other compounds with anti-cancer and health-protective properties, though their stability needs improvement.

supplements.title: Human placental extract ameliorates methotrexate-induced nephrotoxicity in albino rats: ultrastructural, biochemical and biophysical studies.
supplements.summary: Human placental extract reduced kidney damage caused by methotrexate cancer drug in rats by restoring antioxidant protection.

supplements.title: Dehydrocostus Lactone Suppresses Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Inhibiting Protein Tyrosine Kinase-7 Mediated β-Catenin Signaling.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called dehydrocostus lactone fights liver cancer by blocking a protein that drives tumor growth and spread.

supplements.title: Cannabidiol modulates classical and non-classical hla expression in human choriocarcinoma cell line.
supplements.summary: Cannabidiol increases immune-fighting proteins while decreasing immune-suppressing ones in choriocarcinoma cancer cells through distinct receptor pathways.

supplements.title: Oxidative Stress Drives Liver Failure During In Vivo Partial Reprogramming.
supplements.summary: Oxidative stress causes liver failure during sustained reprogramming; antioxidant treatment improves survival without blocking regeneration.

supplements.title: Impact of arid-zone abiotic stress on phytochemical bioactivity: Enhancing chemotherapeutic synergy in breast cancer and personalized therapeutic algorithms.
supplements.summary: Desert plants produce stronger cancer-fighting compounds due to harsh environments, offering promising new breast cancer treatments worth investigating.

supplements.title: Computational exploration of quercetin derivatives from Azadirachta indica leaf as threonine tyrosine kinase inhibitors for potential lung and pancreatic cancer treatment.
supplements.summary: Natural compounds from neem leaves show promise as potential drug candidates against lung and pancreatic cancer cells.

supplements.title: Unveiling medication patterns in traditional Chinese medicine for the prevention of colorectal cancer recurrence: from potential combinations to validation of components and targets.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine herbs, particularly those containing quercetin and kaempferol, show promise in preventing colorectal cancer recurrence through identified molecular targets.

off_label.title: FusionTarget: Computational framework for drug repurposing against modeled fusion protein structures from genomic breakpoints.
off_label.summary: FusionTarget computationally identifies drugs targeting fusion proteins in Ewing sarcoma and infant leukemia by modeling their 3D structures.

off_label.title: Protein tyrosine kinases in dendritic cell-mediated anti-cancer immunity.
off_label.summary: Protein tyrosine kinases control dendritic cells' ability to fight cancer by regulating immune responses, and targeting these proteins may enhance cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: EXPRESS: Dezocine Allevates Cancer-Induced Bone Pain and Suppresses Intraosseous Tumor Growth in Renal Cell Carcinoma via the NAMPT/NAD+ Axis.
off_label.summary: Dezocine reduces pain and suppresses tumor growth in kidney cancer bone metastasis by disrupting a cellular energy pathway.

off_label.title: Astrocytic Phenotypic Switching in Posterior Piriform Cortex Orchestrates Bone Cancer Pain-Depression Comorbidity via Purinergic-Noradrenergic Signaling.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that harmful astrocyte changes in the brain orchestrate bone cancer pain and depression together, offering new treatment targets.

off_label.title: Translating B-Cell and Plasma-Cell Targeting from Oncology to Autoimmunity: Modalities, Quantitative Bridging, and a Development Roadmap.
off_label.summary: B-cell cancer drugs are being successfully adapted to treat autoimmune diseases by targeting immune cells that cause harmful inflammation.

off_label.title: Histone modifications across cancers: mechanisms, therapy and clinical translation.
off_label.summary: Histone modifications drive cancer development; targeting these modifications with new drugs like HDAC and EZH2 inhibitors offers promising therapeutic opportunities.

off_label.title: Recurrent cardiac hydatid cyst: a rare case of initial misdiagnosis and successful surgical management.
off_label.summary: Surgical removal of cardiac hydatid cysts is effective, but post-operative albendazole therapy is essential to prevent dangerous recurrence.

off_label.title: PLD1 and PLD2 promote an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment via CCL19-dependent macrophage polarization and PD-L1 induction.
off_label.summary: Blocking PLD1 and PLD2 enzymes in melanoma reprograms the immune microenvironment and enhances immune cell killing of cancer cells.

off_label.title: Dual targeting of mitochondrial metabolism and Rho GTPase signaling to suppress cancer metastasis (Review).
off_label.summary: Targeting both mitochondrial energy and cellular movement signaling together may block cancer spread better than single therapies alone.

off_label.title: Metformin sensitizes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma to Vγ9Vδ2 T cell-mediated cytotoxicity by upregulating BTN3A1 and BTN2A1.
off_label.summary: Metformin enhances esophageal cancer cell death by increasing proteins that activate immune T cells to attack tumors.

off_label.title: In silico screen identifies Pranidipine as a potential inhibitor of the PD-1/PD-L1 immune checkpoint.
off_label.summary: Computer analysis identifies Pranidipine, a blood pressure medication, as a potential cancer treatment by blocking immune checkpoint proteins.

off_label.title: Protective Effects of Imeglimin Against Oxaliplatin-Induced Peripheral Neurotoxicity: Evidence From In Vitro and In Vivo Studies.
off_label.summary: Imeglimin protects nerve cells from oxaliplatin damage in gastrointestinal cancer treatment without reducing the drug's anticancer effectiveness.

off_label.title: Nitazoxanide cooperates with cytarabine to inhibit cytarabine-resistant acute myeloid leukemia progression via mitochondrial dysfunction and PLK1 suppression.
off_label.summary: Nitazoxanide combined with cytarabine overcomes drug resistance in acute myeloid leukemia by damaging mitochondria and blocking cell division.

off_label.title: Recurrent pregnancy loss and thyroid autoimmunity: A review of mechanisms and clinical management.
off_label.summary: Thyroid autoimmunity increases miscarriage risk in women and may be treatable with medications like levothyroxine and immunosuppressants.

off_label.title: Targeting XIAP-coordinated PKC signaling resensitizes PD-1-refractory tumors for rechallenge.
off_label.summary: PKC inhibition resensitizes PD-1-resistant lung cancer to immunotherapy by reactivating immune cell killing and reducing tumor protection.

biomarkers.title: Ubiquitination-anchored signature defines neuroendocrine prostate cancer: hub genes and single-cell ecosystem insights from integrated bioinformatics analysis of public transcriptomic datasets.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified ubiquitination-related genes as key drivers of aggressive neuroendocrine prostate cancer, offering potential diagnostic and treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Dual-ligand-modified cantharidin nanoparticles for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma via the inhibition of Ephb4.
biomarkers.summary: Modified nanoparticles delivering cantharidin effectively treat liver cancer by blocking a specific protein pathway while reducing toxic side effects.

biomarkers.title: Optimization of lens size and ion source parameters for gas chromatography/mass spectrometry-based metabolomics using hydrogen as a carrier gas.
biomarkers.summary: Optimized hydrogen-based mass spectrometry effectively identified metabolic changes in colon cancer cells with IDH1 mutations, offering a viable helium alternative.

biomarkers.title: An integrated derivatization-LC-MS strategy reveals cell-type-specific chiral amino acid profiles.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a method to detect chiral amino acids, revealing distinct patterns in breast cancer cells that could help identify cancer biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: Chronic stress at the crossroads: Decoding the HPA-SAM-immune-gut axis in inflammatory bowel disease pathogenesis and therapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Chronic stress worsens inflammatory bowel disease by disrupting immune function and gut bacteria; psychological therapies combined with standard treatments may help.

biomarkers.title: CCL19-armed oncolytic adenovirus synergizes with CCR7-expressing CAR-T cells to suppress ovarian tumor growth.
biomarkers.summary: A modified virus that attracts immune cells helps CAR-T cells infiltrate and suppress ovarian tumors more effectively than CAR-T cells alone.

biomarkers.title: The Link Between Diabetes and Cancer: Converging Mechanistic and Epidemiologic Evidence.
biomarkers.summary: Diabetes increases risk for breast, colorectal, endometrial, liver, pancreatic, and gallbladder cancers through insulin resistance and chronic inflammation pathways.

biomarkers.title: PET Imaging Characterization of Sphingosine-1-Phosphate Receptor 2 in a Mouse Model of Esophageal Adenocarcinoma and Metastatic Lymph Node.
biomarkers.summary: A new imaging tracer successfully detects elevated S1PR2 protein in esophageal adenocarcinoma tumors and metastatic lymph nodes, offering diagnostic potential.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of the efficacy of rutin, rutin nanocrystals, and rutin spanlastics nanoparticles as antitumor and antioxidant drug delivery systems.
biomarkers.summary: Rutin delivered as spanlastic nanoparticles showed superior antioxidant and anticancer effects against breast cancer cells compared to regular rutin.

biomarkers.title: Evaluating total tumor load (TTL) to predict metastasis in four or more axillary lymph nodes in HR +/HER2- breast cancer patients: the TULIP4N + study.
biomarkers.summary: A new test measuring tumor markers in lymph nodes helps identify breast cancer patients who need additional drug therapy.

biomarkers.title: The biphasic interactions between ferroptosis and oxidative stress: from molecular mechanisms to disease interventions.
biomarkers.summary: High-intensity oxidative stress triggers ferroptosis cell death, while moderate stress activates protective mechanisms—a framework applicable across neurodegenerative diseases, cancer, and ischemia.

biomarkers.title: Integrating multi-omics and clinical management in breast cancer: a comprehensive review.
biomarkers.summary: Integrating multiple molecular data types with liquid biopsy improves breast cancer treatment personalization and resistance monitoring.

biomarkers.title: MicroRNA-SIRT1 crosstalk in liver diseases: molecular regulation of metabolism, inflammation, and cell survival.
biomarkers.summary: MicroRNA-SIRT1 interactions regulate liver metabolism and inflammation, with disruption linked to hepatocellular carcinoma and other liver diseases.

biomarkers.title: Integrated Genomic, Structural, and Metabolomic Profiling of Freeze-Dried Postbiotic Supernatants Reveals Multi-Target Anticancer Activity Against Caco-2 Cells.
biomarkers.summary: Bacterial metabolites derived from probiotics show promise against colorectal cancer cells by triggering cell death and stopping tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: Comparative evaluation of different MALDI-TOF-MS platforms for plasma IgG N-glycan profiling: impact on analytical performance and clinical conclusions.
biomarkers.summary: Two mass spectrometry platforms reliably measure immune protein glycans to identify pancreatic cancer with consistent diagnostic accuracy.

trials.title: CCL19-armed oncolytic adenovirus synergizes with CCR7-expressing CAR-T cells to suppress ovarian tumor growth.
trials.summary: A modified virus that attracts immune cells helps CAR-T cells infiltrate and suppress ovarian tumors more effectively than CAR-T cells alone.

trials.title: Evaluating total tumor load (TTL) to predict metastasis in four or more axillary lymph nodes in HR +/HER2- breast cancer patients: the TULIP4N + study.
trials.summary: A new test measuring tumor markers in lymph nodes helps identify breast cancer patients who need additional drug therapy.

trials.title: Integrating multi-omics and clinical management in breast cancer: a comprehensive review.
trials.summary: Integrating multiple molecular data types with liquid biopsy improves breast cancer treatment personalization and resistance monitoring.

trials.title: Impact of medical oncologist certification on survival outcomes in metastatic colorectal cancer: evidence from the SCRUM-Japan MONSTAR-SCREEN Observational Study.
trials.summary: Medical oncologist board certification is linked to better survival outcomes in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.

trials.title: The tumor microenvironment in triple negative breast cancer and a strategy to improve responses to immunotherapy using cryoablation and immunostimulants.
trials.summary: Combining cryoablation with immunotherapy drugs may improve treatment outcomes for triple-negative breast cancer by activating the immune system.

trials.title: Targeted therapy in BRAF‑mutant melanoma: Advances and challenges (Review).
trials.summary: BRAF inhibitors effectively treat melanoma but patients develop drug resistance, requiring new strategies to prevent aggressive cancer relapse.

trials.title: Targeting regulatory T cells in the prostate cancer microenvironment: From mechanisms to therapeutics (Review).
trials.summary: Targeting specific regulatory T cell subsets in prostate cancer tumors could improve immunotherapy effectiveness and prevent treatment-induced immune suppression.

trials.title: Covalent inhibitors of human papillomavirus type 16 E6 protein restore p53 function and suppress growth of HPV-driven tumors in vivo.
trials.summary: A new drug blocks HPV-16's cancer protein, restoring tumor suppressor p53 function and shrinking cervical and oropharyngeal tumors in mice.

trials.title: Protein tyrosine kinases in dendritic cell-mediated anti-cancer immunity.
trials.summary: Protein tyrosine kinases control dendritic cells' ability to fight cancer by regulating immune responses, and targeting these proteins may enhance cancer immunotherapy.

trials.title: Quality of life and mental health in pediatric patients with low-grade CNS tumors treated with surgery alone.
trials.summary: Children with low-grade brain tumors treated with surgery alone experience reduced quality of life and mental health challenges compared to healthy peers.

trials.title: Impact of prior nivolumab on treatment outcomes of taxane plus ramucirumab in advanced gastric cancer.
trials.summary: Prior immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment may improve how well taxane plus ramucirumab works for advanced gastric cancer.

trials.title: Diagnostic Challenges in Oncogenic Osteomalacia due to Intracranial Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor: A Case Report.
trials.summary: A rare brain tumor causing bone weakness was successfully treated with surgery, leading to complete recovery and normalized bone health.

trials.title: Engagement of the TCR against an oncolytic virus generates a population of effector CAR T cells with potent antitumor activity.
trials.summary: Combining CAR T cells with oncolytic virus therapy enhances T cell durability and anti-tumor activity in solid tumors.

trials.title: Differential DNA damage response to WRN inhibition identifies a targetable vulnerability in ARID1A-mutated cancers.
trials.summary: Blocking WRN protein selectively kills ARID1A-mutated cancers, especially when combined with p21 inhibition.

trials.title: Cytotoxic CD39+ tumor-associated NK cells respond to NKG2A blockade in lung cancer.
trials.summary: Blocking NKG2A enhances the cancer-killing ability of CD39+ immune cells in lung cancer patients.
